questions.explain: Defer sharding: exhaust read scale-out, bigger compute/Hyperscale, caching, and workload isolation first. If unavoidable, shard by tenant with a shard-map database; cross-shard queries go through the analytics pipeline, never chat-path cross-database joins.
options: Shard by tenant only after exhausting read scale-out, bigger compute, caching, and workload isolation — shard-map DB, cross-shard via analytics pipeline

questions.explain: Tier 0 (conversations, audit, ledger): zero data loss, synchronous replication + PITR, hash-chain verification after restore. Tier 1 (vectors): recoverable by re-ingest, keep geo-replicated backups. Tier 2 (caches): not backed up, warming rebuilds. Tier 3 (sessions): expected to be lost.
options: Four tiers: zero-loss for conversations/audit/ledger, re-ingestible vectors, rebuildable caches, expendable sessions
